findings.title: 定时续办生成被过滤的话题边界，跳过已关闭段的小结和自动记忆
findings.aliasDisposition: Author132 and independent136 assess one cause; Root promotes the same candidate once. Original frozen author candidate counts retained.
findings.validation: Static actual future-registration→idle wake→dispatch→protocol→transcript→default closure reader/locator chain, independently reviewed. No PET helper/test/model/clock/session execution. The separate static-file shard is not validation of this finding.
findings.condition: An existing active topic S0 has at least3 meaningful ordinary messages, auto-extract is enabled, and an accepted user-authorized resume follow-up with a valid idle source and no pending decision wakes after the configured idle gap (default12h), taking the ordinary chat wake branch rather than paused-task direct resume. The worker run completes normally.
findings.expected: Closing S0 should locate its next boundary and perform the ordinary journal/auto-memory extraction; the next active topic should retain a boundary that the closure reader can locate.
findings.actual: wakeFollowUp creates H=pet-followup-ID-revision. The shared chat branch calls beginTurn(H), closing S0 with endH and opening S1 with startH. The same run persists H with injected:true. After run settle, the default closure reader filters that user message, so locateClosureWindow cannot find endH and returns null; close returns before extraction. Later closing S1 also cannot find startH. Backfill reuses the same persisted IDs and reader.
findings.impact: The just-closed topic S0 loses its automatic journal/auto-memory extraction under these conditions; the following H-anchored segment also fails at its next closure. Raw transcript is retained, earlier successful journals remain, and a later topic anchored to a real user can recover. No claim that the separate Core span/context archival path fails.
counterevidence: First interaction or a gap shorter than idleMs does not create this boundary.
Notify-only reminders, unavailable/external/running/pending sources and paused-task direct resume are outside the trigger.
A later ordinary user starting a fresh topic can create a healthy new anchor; it does not rewrite the closed H-bounded segments.
Ordinary assistant transcript writers do not duplicate H in message.data; stream-envelope correlation IDs are not transcript anchor fields. Independent136 verifies this finite writer/wiring chain.

Old persist-mimi-archive-boundary plan866 explicitly discusses injected skipping and separate span archival; that design discussion is preserved and is not evidence that journal extraction has a fallback.
findings.deduplication: Shared5676 MD/recursive JSON-value history (archives included, formal57+ excluded) is machine navigation, not exhaustive semantic coverage. Author132 additionally read bounded focused windows and original topic/closure old-full evidence. Existing PET search defects are distinct; the old injected/span design discussion is related background, not the exact follow-up boundary→journal null cause. No first-ever or exhaustive historical-absence claim.
findings.fixDirection: Keep stored topic boundaries locatable under the closure reader’s injected-message policy while preserving the independent context-archive behavior.
